# Opinion Writing Picture Prompt Planner

Subject: Writing
Grade band: K-2
Resource type: Writing Planner
NYS framework label: NYS Next Generation ELA Learning Standards

## Short Description
A visual planner for young writers to state an opinion, give a reason, and add a closing.

## Alignment Note
Supports early opinion writing, oral rehearsal, and sentence development.

## Classroom Use Case
Use with a picture prompt before students draft in journals.

## Preview Content
- My opinion
- One reason
- Closing sentence

## Teacher Notes
This original StandardCraft resource is intended to support planning and classroom use. It is not issued by NYSED and does not replace district curriculum, local requirements, or teacher professional judgment.
